title: TELOS unsigned integrity-hash receipt (telos/0.1-unsigned)
description: The canonical envelope minted per observed agent action by the telos-receipt package. The integrity hash is a key-free SHA-256 over the canonical JSON (sort_keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii escapes) of `payload`. It confirms the payload matches the recorded hash; it is not a digital signature and does not establish who issued the receipt or when. `signature` is null in this contract version and `signing_status` declares the unsigned state; a later signed contract fills `signature` without changing this shape.

receipt_version.description: Which receipt contract produced this record. The name states the unsigned status.

kind.description: What kind of record this is. `action_governed` is one reviewed action; other kinds share the same envelope.

agent_id.description: Which agent did the work. A label the operating team assigns.

payload.description: The part the integrity hash covers: everything the record commits to. Must be JSON-native and finite; values with no canonical JSON form are refused at mint time.

issued_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of issue. Metadata, deliberately outside the hash, so the same logical payload always yields the same hash.

integrity_hash.description: Key-free SHA-256 over the canonical JSON serialization of `payload`. Recompute offline and compare; a match confirms the payload has not changed relative to the recorded hash.

covered_fields.description: States exactly what the hash covers.

signing_status.description: The receipt's own declaration that it is unsigned in this contract version.

signature.description: Null in telos/0.1-unsigned: not signed yet, and the receipt says so on itself. A later signed contract version fills this field and changes signing_status, with no change to the envelope shape.

engine.description: Which engine produced the payload. Honest labeling: the v0.1 default states that no governance engine is wired.

action_params_hash.description: SHA-256 commitment to the exact action parameters. Raw arguments are never echoed, so the receipt is shareable without leaking content.

verdict.description: The review outcome, from the public verdict vocabulary.

composite_score.description: Overall score of the action against its purpose anchor.

pa_id.description: The purpose anchor: the declared, human-specified purpose the action was measured against.
